newsitem.title: USA: Consumers 67 MW nuke shut while ramping up.
newsitem.headline: Consumers 67 MW nuke shut while ramping up.

text.p: Consumers Power Co's 67 megawatt Big Rock Point nuclear power plant was shut as of early Friday, interrupting the ramping up process from an earlier outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The plant, in Charlevoix, Mich., was shut due to a turbine vibration, the NRC said in its daily plant status report Friday.
The unit had been operating at 20 percent of capacity as of early Thursday, building power from an outage which began last weekend to repair an unstable main generator field current.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment on the timing of a possible restart of the plant.
